questions.question: Describe the general characteristics of the phylum Bryophyta. Give two economic importance.
questions.solution:
**Characteristics:**
- Small, non-vascular plants (no true roots, stems, leaves)
- Dominant gametophyte generation
- Require water for fertilization
- Thalloid or leafy body
- Examples: Marchantia, Funaria

**Economic importance:**
1. Peat moss (Sphagnum) — fuel, packing material
2. Used as ornamental plants; some used in traditional medicine
questions.knowledgeNote: Bryophytes are 'amphibians of plant kingdom' — need water for reproduction.

questions.question: Differentiate between dicotyledonous and monocotyledonous angiosperms with one example of each.
questions.solution:
Angiosperms are divided into **Dicotyledonae (dicots)** and **Monocotyledonae (monocots)**:

| Feature | Dicotyledonae (dicots) | Monocotyledonae (monocots) |
|---|---|---|
| **Cotyledons** | **Two** cotyledons in the seed | **One** cotyledon (the scutellum) |
| **Leaf venation** | **Reticulate (net-like)** | **Parallel** |
| **Root system** | **Tap root** bearing lateral roots; shows secondary growth | **Fibrous/adventitious** root system; no secondary growth |
| **Stem** | Vascular bundles arranged in a **ring**; has vascular cambium and shows secondary growth | Vascular bundles **scattered** in the ground tissue; no cambium |
| **Flower** | Parts in **fours or fives** — 5 sepals, 5 petals, 5 stamens, 2 carpels | Parts in **threes or multiples of three** — 5 sepals absent, usually 3+3 per whorl |
| **Stomata** | Present on **both** surfaces of the leaf | Present mostly on the **lower** surface only |
| **Pollen grains** | **Tricolpate** (three colpi) | **Monocolpate** (one colpus) |
| **Examples** | Potato (*Solanum tuberosum*), tomato, pea (*Pisum*), mustard (*Brassica*) | Onion (*Allium cepa*), maize (*Zea mays*), rice, wheat, sugarcane |

**Conclusion:** Dicots have two cotyledons, reticulate venation and a ring of vascular bundles, whereas monocots have one cotyledon, parallel venation and scattered vascular bundles.
questions.knowledgeNote: Dicots have two cotyledons, reticulate venation and a tap root; monocots have one cotyledon, parallel venation and fibrous roots.
